name: Germanic Berserker
notes: CR 2. Francisca throw THEN greataxe. Reckless Attack. Danger Sense. Leads the ladder charge for Vercingetorix.
gm_notes: Session 2 raid, Phase 1-2, leads ladder assault. Two berserkers, one per western ladder. Turn 1: throw francisca at the nearest wall defender before closing (range 20/60, 1d6+3 slashing). Then charge ladder. Half speed on ladder. Reckless Attack the moment they reach the parapet -- this is the wall's most dangerous moment. Danger Sense: advantage on Dex saves against effects they can see (e.g. ballista fire, oil flasks). These are Vercingetorix's champions, not cult-maddened soldiers. They are angry, disciplined, and here for the spear.
